biggest_catch: Your only referral reward is a 10% lifetime share of each referral's earnings — the friend keeps 100% of theirs and gets no referral bonus, so you earn nothing from referrals who don't stay active.
catches: Referrer gets 10% of each referred user's earnings for life; the referred user still receives their full earnings — the bonus is paid by EarnApp on top.
The referred user gets no extra referral bonus — only their normal device earnings.
The referral percentage may change from time to time.
If you and your referral share the same IP at registration, you only get partial earnings from them.
Fraud (e.g., self-referring) leads to account termination with no payout of the balance.
No cap on the number of referrals was stated.

c1.evidence: EarnApp (by Bright Data) — established internet-sharing passive income app; official help.earnapp.com support article.

c2.evidence: Official EarnApp support article states the 10% lifetime referral income, that users keep full earnings, and the same-IP caveat.

c3.evidence: No fee to participate in the referral program.

c4.evidence: Official help center: 'will earn you a lifetime income of 10% extra of their earnings (users still receive their full earnings).' Honest disclosure: percentage-based, friend-side bonus not offered.

eligibility: Referrer: an EarnApp user sharing their referral link. Friend: a new user who signs up via the referral link (not on the same IP at registration for full earnings).
notes: Official EarnApp help center article reviewed 2026-09-23. Third-party sites mention a separate BrightVPN referral program — kept separate per the official docs; this route covers only the standard 10% EarnApp referral program. No EarnApp routes exist in the catalog, so no duplication.
payout_quote: Official EarnApp help center: 'Users who sign up using your EarnApp referral link will earn you a lifetime income of 10% extra of their earnings (users still receive their full earnings). The percentage of referral earnings may change from time to time. NOTE: If you and your referral share the same IP at the moment of the registration, you will only get partial earnings from him. WARNING: If we detect fraud (for example, self-referring) we will TERMINATE your account, and any earnings you have on your balance WILL NOT BE PAID.'

s1.note: Friend signs up via the referrer's link; referrer earns 10% of the friend's earnings for life.

s2.note: 10% of referral earnings for life, paid in EarnApp balance — exact percentage; no upfront fee.

s3.note: Lifetime, ongoing; percentage may change over time; no stated cap or expiry.

s4.note: '10% extra of their earnings' stated flatly for the referrer; friend-side: no bonus (keeps full earnings) — disclosed honestly.

s5.note: https://help.earnapp.com/hc/en-us/articles/10232037405073 — official EarnApp help center, found in search 2026-09-23.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: share link, friend signs up, both earn, referrer gets 10% extra.

s7.note: Official EarnApp help center article reviewed 2026-09-23 (search extract with full article text).

steps: Install EarnApp and copy your referral link from your dashboard.
Share the link with friends (not on your own network/IP).
Your friend signs up with your link and runs EarnApp.
Your friend earns their normal device earnings in full.
You receive an additional 10% of their earnings, credited to your EarnApp balance for as long as they earn.
Withdraw via PayPal when you reach the payout threshold.
timing: Lifetime for as long as referrals earn; the referral percentage may change over time.
